text:
sam: CI perf/regression spike on staging after merge of PR #4128. p95 jumped from ~28ms -> ~82ms on small_seq workload. https://ci.redwood/internal/4567/profile.tar.gz :frowning:
ci-bot: perf-run failed: test/stable-throughput (job 4567). artifacts uploaded.
maria: ugh. did any kernel-selection changes land in that PR?
sam: PR touched kernel-selector heuristics + kv prefetch. main suspect commit abcdef123 (see diff).
jon: starting git bisect across main..release/v1.9 to find culprit. will update.
jon: bisect result -> commit abcdef123 (author: lee). change in choose_kernel_for_seqlen() heuristics.
kyle: can we revert only the kernel heuristic and keep kv prefetch? which is lower risk to backport?
sam: kernel change increases batch packing which bumps tail latencies for small batches; kv prefetch increases occupancy so amplifies tail. both interact.
lee: I can open a revert on main and a backport to release/v1.9. pinging @eng-oncall for canary gating.
maria: for verification, run: ./tools/perf_run --workload=small_seq --iters=100 and attach perf_summary.txt. also capture batch-size distribution.
jon: ran local perf, snippet below:
``
p95 baseline: 29.8ms
p95 after abcdef123: 81.7ms
cpu util +12%
batch-size median 4 -> 9
``
sam: thanks. that's consistent. Lee please open revert PRs and include a staged canary plan (2 staging nodes).
lee: created PRs: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/5123 (revert) and https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/5124 (backport). CI green but need manual canary + perf-run.
maria: scheduling canary at 09:30 UTC. @eng-oncall please watch kv.cache.stalls metric and p95. gating conditions: kv.cache.stalls > 0.5% OR p95 > 50ms -> abort.
eng-oncall: watching. will alert if kv.cache.stalls > 0.5% or p95 > 50ms.
sam: if canary passes, cut hotfix 1.9.1 with cherry-pick of revert commit. if fails, we consider rolling forward with throttled batching heuristic and immediate e2e.
kyle: add regression e2e that asserts p95(small_seq) < 35ms to prevent recurrence.
sam: added test ticket and gating to release checklist. thanks all :thumbsup:
